info.title: Other - common-mpls-static
info.description:
This module contains a collection of YANG definitions for
     configuring static MPLS LSPs.

**Authentication**: HTTP Basic Authentication

**Protocol**: RESTCONF (RFC 8040)

**Base Path**: https://{device}/restconf/data

**YANG Model:** [common-mpls-static.yang](https://github.com/YangModels/yang/blob/main/vendor/cisco/xe/17181/common-mpls-static.yang)

**📊 YANG Tree:** [View common-mpls-static structure](https://jeremycohoe.github.io/cisco-ios-xe-openapi-swagger/yang-trees/common-mpls-static.html)
